top_signals.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. escort, as Treasury widens sanctions
top_signals.summary: Iran said three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, as the U.S. escalates sanctions aimed at cutting off Tehran's financial lifelines.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: LME to List New Aluminum Brand as Historic Squeeze Deepens
top_signals.summary: The London Metal Exchange is preparing to authorize deliveries of aluminum from a major new smelter in Indonesia into its warehousing network, offering potential supply relief as a historic squeeze roils the global market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Iranian Floating Crude Storage Drops to Under 4 Million Barrels
top_signals.summary: Iran’s floating crude storage in Asia is nearly gone. Windward put Iranian crude stored on tankers off Malaysia at about 70 million barrels in January, and at most about 3.8 million barrels remain. The tankers that delivered that crude are sitting empty off Sri Lanka.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
